title: refactor: unify safety input preparation
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces route-specific safety helpers with one typed input preparer
- Preserves existing text, chat, image, video, 3D, and audio prompt behavior
- Keeps guardrail policy, batching, redaction, and failure handling unchanged
- Adds direct coverage for batched text inputs

No public API or model configuration changes.

gist.headline: One safety gate, many doors
gist.blurb: The hive now prepares every kind of prompt through one tidy safety path. Same guardrails, fewer route-specific weeds to water.
gist.summary: Unified text, chat, image, video, 3D, and audio safety-input preparation behind one typed middleware helper while preserving existing guardrail policy, batching, redaction, and failure behavior.
gist.impact: Generation requests keep their existing safety behavior, with direct test coverage now ensuring batched text prompts travel through the shared preparation path correctly.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden keeper at a single cozy checkpoint where several labeled prompt parcels—text, chat bubbles, an image tile, film strip, tiny 3D cube, and music note—are gently sorted into one glowing preparation basket; small code-plants and a neat batch of text seeds show the shared typed path and batched-input coverage.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: "ONE PATH".
